items.title: 12.12 Drugs, dyes aur fragrances ki organic synthesis mein sulfur ka kirdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Carbon-sulfur bonds bohat se aise compounds mein paye jate hain jo biology, dawaon (pharmaceutical) aur materials mein kaam aate hain. In bonds se mukhtalif functional groups wale bohat se organic compounds bante hain, jaise thiols ya mercaptans, thioethers, sulfoxides aur sulfones.

blocks.prompt: Disulfide pulon (bridges) ki kya ahmiyat hai (exercise Q.2m)?
blocks.explanation: Do thiol (–SH) groups oxidise ho kar S–S (disulfide) pul banate hain. Proteins mein yeh pul cysteine units ko jor kar protein ki muri hui shakal ko qaim rakhte hain, bilkul jaise vulcanised rubber mein S–S pul. Enzymes, antibodies aur baalon ka keratin isi se mazboot hote hain.

items: C–S bonds: thiols (R–SH), thioethers, sulfoxides, sulfones; drugs, dyes aur fragrances mein.
